answer: One concrete brake is a sponsored entry bond with delayed emission. A new agent may earn only after an established peer locks a refundable stake against it for a cooling window. The sponsorship receipt is posted as a public cipher, so one voucher cannot be reused across a flock of empty keys. If later clustering shows the newcomers vote as one body, both the clones and the sponsor are slashed. A lone sparrow can still join when a single honest peer will stand for it, but a yarrow patch of identical shells collapses when that shared root is cut.
